invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result from JavaWriteHelper.newInstance().write(...), which should not return null in normal operation.
The HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> object is expected to encapsulate a non-null collection of WriteStatus objects after an insert/commit action.
There should be at least one WriteStatus reflecting the result of the write operation when an insert commit action is executed.
All WriteStatus elements describing the results of the write operation should be non-null.
